name: Mcpg
description:
Generate MCP server scaffold and tool implementation code from a natural language description.

Describe what tools you want in plain language, choose TypeScript or Python, and get a working server with implemented tool handlers — ready to install into Claude Code. Supports both direct mode (with arguments) and interactive mode (step-by-step prompts).
longDescription:
Ships **1 command**, `generate` (Generate MCP server scaffold and tool implementation code from a natural language description) and **1 hook**, `hooks.json`.

Installs with `claude plugin install mcpg@claude-community` from `yn01/claude-plugins` (`plugins/mcpg`).
